dialogue.content: お疲れ様です。カウンセラー役を勤めさせていただきます。19:30ちょうどになったら開始させていただきますね。
dialogue.English: Good evening. I will be your counselor today. We will begin right at 7:30 PM.

dialogue.content: oお願いします
dialogue.English: Okay, thank you.

dialogue.content: はい！そしたら、次のメッセージから始めさせていただきますね。
dialogue.English: Okay! Then, we'll start with the next message.

dialogue.content: こんばんは 相談員です。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm your counselor. It's a pleasure to speak with you.

dialogue.content: よそ陸お願いします
dialogue.English: It's a pleasure to speak with you too.

dialogue.content: はい、お願いします。
dialogue.English: Yes, likewise.

dialogue.content: ご相談頂くにあたって、性別、年齢、また今日はなんとお呼びすれば良いか、
dialogue.English: Before we begin our consultation, could you please tell me your gender, age, and what you would like me to call you today,

dialogue.content: 答えられる範囲で教えていただいてもいいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: to the extent that you feel comfortable?

dialogue.content: 20代、女性りさ
dialogue.English: I'm a woman in my 20s. Please call me Risa.

dialogue.content: りささんですね。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Risa, I see. It's a pleasure to meet you.

dialogue.content: 今日はどういったご相談でしたか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 結婚をしたくなくて
dialogue.English: I don't want to get married.

dialogue.content: なるほど…結婚がしたくない。そう思われているんですね
dialogue.English: I see... you don't want to get married. So that's how you're feeling.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 是非とも詳しく聴かせていただきたいです。具体的にどんなことがあったのか、伺っても良いでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I would very much like to hear more about that. Would you mind telling me what has been happening specifically?

dialogue.content: 彼氏と、周りがどんどん決めて
dialogue.English: My boyfriend and the people around me are just moving things along so quickly...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 私はまだそんな気持ちになれなくて
dialogue.English: But I'm just not in that mindset yet.

dialogue.content: なるほど…
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それは辛いですよね、、自分の気持ちが置いてけぼりに…
dialogue.English: That must be difficult... to feel like your own feelings are being left behind.

dialogue.content: そうなのです
dialogue.English: That's exactly it.

dialogue.content: なるほど…話を進めているのは、彼氏さんや他にはどんな方がいらっしゃるのですか？
dialogue.English: I see… Besides your boyfriend, who else is pushing things forward?

dialogue.content: 友だち
dialogue.English: My friends.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。彼氏さんだけでなく、ご友人にも話を進めらると、困ってしまいますよね、、
dialogue.English: I see. It must be distressing to have not only your boyfriend but also your friends pushing this forward.

dialogue.content: なんか…後がないよって言われて
dialogue.English: They tell me... that I'm running out of chances.

dialogue.content: ええ…それは息が詰まるような気持ちになりますよね、
dialogue.English: Oh... that must feel suffocating.

dialogue.content: ないのも困るなって
dialogue.English: And I do worry that having no chances left would also be a problem.

dialogue.content: なるほど…先ほど、りささんはまだ結婚するお気持ちにはなれないということでしたが
dialogue.English: I see... You mentioned earlier that you don't feel ready to get married yet,

dialogue.content: 今、りささんとしてはどんな思いをされているのでしょうか…？
dialogue.English: how are you feeling about all of this right now...?

dialogue.content: いつかは、結婚はしたいけど
dialogue.English: I do want to get married someday, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今の彼氏、いい人なんだけど…
dialogue.English: my current boyfriend is a good person, but...

dialogue.content: うん、うん…
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm...

dialogue.content: づっと一緒にいたいかといわれると、そうでもない
dialogue.English: if I'm asked if I want to be with him forever, I'm not so sure.

dialogue.content: なるほど…そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see... so that's how it is.

dialogue.content: そう思っているのに、周りに話を一方的に進められたら、辛くなってしまいますよね。。
dialogue.English: It must be very painful to have others push the conversation forward one-sidedly when you feel that way.

dialogue.content: そう思うのも無理はないと私は思います。
dialogue.English: I think it's only natural to feel that way.

dialogue.content: はい。でも確かに、後はないかもとも思うし
dialogue.English: Yes. But I also do think that maybe I won't get another chance.

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: いい人なんだけど
dialogue.English: He's a good person, but...

dialogue.content: なんだかなあ
dialogue.English: I don’t know… something just feels off.

dialogue.content: 悩んでしまうんですね…
dialogue.English: So you're feeling very conflicted...

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 相談員さんなら、どうしますか？
dialogue.English: If you were in my position, what would you do?

dialogue.content: そうですね、私なら、やっぱり一旦話を聞いて欲しい！と思うかなぁ。
dialogue.English: Let's see... If it were me, I think I'd want them to just stop and listen to what I have to say.

dialogue.content: 別れたいわけでもないし…
dialogue.English: It's not like I want to break up with him...

dialogue.content: りささんはどう思いますか？
dialogue.English: What do you think, Risa?

dialogue.content: いつまで待てばいい？って聞かれるけど、わからない
dialogue.English: He asks me, 'How long do I have to wait?' but I don't know the answer.

dialogue.content: なるほど…そう聞かれると、むしろ困ってしまいますよね
dialogue.English: I see... Being asked that must put you in a very difficult position.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: りささんとしては、彼氏さんには悩んでるお気持ちをどのように伝えられたのですか？
dialogue.English: How have you been able to convey these conflicted feelings to your boyfriend?

dialogue.content: 何も言えてない
dialogue.English: I haven't been able to say anything.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 言おうとすると…どんなお気持ちになりますか？
dialogue.English: When you try to say it, how do you feel?

dialogue.content: わがままかなって
dialogue.English: I wonder if I’m being selfish.

dialogue.content: いい人で、収入もあって、思ってくれてて
dialogue.English: He's a good person, has a stable income, and he cares for me.

dialogue.content: うん、うん。
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: でも、なにか　足りない
dialogue.English: But... something is missing.

dialogue.content: なるほど…
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 相手が良い人だと思っているからこそ、辛くなりますよね。。
dialogue.English: It's especially painful precisely because you think he's such a good person.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうしたら、今日の相談では
dialogue.English: In that case, for today’s session,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: りささんが彼氏さんに対して伝えたい思いや…「足りないと感じる何か」。これがはっきりすると、気分が明るくなるかもしれません。どう思われますか？
dialogue.English: perhaps if we can clarify the feelings you want to convey to your boyfriend... and this 'something that feels missing,' you might feel a bit brighter. What do you think about that?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That sounds good.

dialogue.content: お願いします。
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: はい。ここまでお話を聞いていて、是非一緒に考えさせて頂きたいと思っています。
dialogue.English: Yes. Having listened to your story so far, I would very much like to think this through together with you.

dialogue.content: お願いします。
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: はい。ここまでのことを一旦整理しますが…
dialogue.English: Alright. Let me summarize what I’ve heard so far…

dialogue.content: りささんにはお付き合いしている彼氏さんがいますが、自分の気持ちが固まっていない中で、結婚の話を進められてしまい…周りのご友人からも「後がないよ」と言われている。自分の気持ちも伝えたいけど、わがままかな？と感じてしまう。
dialogue.English: You, Risa, have a boyfriend you're dating, but the topic of marriage is being pushed forward even though you're not sure about your own feelings. Your friends are also telling you that you're 'running out of chances.' You want to express your own feelings, but you feel like that might be selfish.

dialogue.content: 間違いはありませんか？
dialogue.English: Did I get that right?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes, that's correct.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。改めて、モヤモヤする中で気持ちを伝えてくれてありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you. And thank you again for sharing your feelings with me, especially when things are so unclear for you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: You're welcome.

dialogue.content: りささんが自分の気持ちを伝えたいと思ったときのことですが…その時、どんな思いになったか、教えていただいても良いですか？
dialogue.English: Regarding the times you've wanted to express your own feelings... could you tell me what thoughts or feelings came up for you then?

dialogue.content: まだ結婚はしたくないなって
dialogue.English: That I just don't want to get married yet.

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: そう思われたんですね。けれど、わがままかな…と思われたのですね。
dialogue.English: That’s how you felt. And at the same time, you wondered if that was selfish.

dialogue.content: 別れたいとも思っていない
dialogue.English: I don’t want to break up, either.

dialogue.content: うん、うん。
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: はい。わがままかなって
dialogue.English: Yes. I wonder if it’s selfish.

dialogue.content: マリッジブルーなんかではないです。
dialogue.English: It's not something like 'marriage blues'.

dialogue.content: なるほど、そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see, so that's how it is.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 彼氏さんは、りささんがこうやって悩まれていること、どれくらい知っているのでしょうか…？
dialogue.English: How much does your boyfriend know about how much you’re struggling with this?

dialogue.content: あんまり知らないと思います。
dialogue.English: I don't think he really knows.

dialogue.content: なるほど……その状態が続いたら、虚しいですよね。。
dialogue.English: I see... It must feel empty for that situation to continue.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: もしも、なんでも伝えられるとしたら。何を言っても「わがままじゃない」としたら、彼氏さんにはどんなことを伝えたいですか？もちろん、本当に言うかどうかは今は考えなくても大丈夫ですよ。
dialogue.English: If you could say anything at all, and if you knew that whatever you said wouldn't be considered 'selfish,' what would you want to tell your boyfriend? Of course, you don't have to think about whether you'd actually say it right now.

dialogue.content: ねえ、はなしきいてる?って
dialogue.English: 'Hey, are you even listening to me?'

dialogue.content: うん、うん。。
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm...

dialogue.content: もしまだ浮かぶ言葉があれば、いくらでも書いて大丈夫ですよ。
dialogue.English: If any other words come to mind, please feel free to write as much as you like.

dialogue.content: 貴方は楽しいでしょう。私は？
dialogue.English: 'You must be happy. But what about me?'

dialogue.content: うん。
dialogue.English: I hear you.

dialogue.content: なんでも分かった風に言わないで
dialogue.English: 'Don't act like you understand everything.'

dialogue.content: そうですよね。わかったふうに言わないで欲しい。
dialogue.English: Right. You don't want him to act like he understands.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そのまま、もしもこのまま結婚したらどうなるか、りささんだったら何て伝えたいですか？
dialogue.English: Following that train of thought, if you were to get married as things are now, what would you want to tell him about how that would be?

dialogue.content: う～ん　それはよくわからない
dialogue.English: Hmm... I'm not really sure.

dialogue.content: 結婚したことないから
dialogue.English: I've never been married before.

dialogue.content: なるほど！今、こうやってお気持ちをいくつか伺いましたが
dialogue.English: I see! Now that we've talked through some of these feelings,

dialogue.content: 気持ちを表現してみて…りささんは今どんな思いですか？
dialogue.English: how are you feeling now that you've expressed them?

dialogue.content: 言えたら楽かなって
dialogue.English: I think I'd feel relieved if I could say these things.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。
dialogue.English: Yes, I can imagine.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 私はりささんの話を伺って、自分のことをちゃんと考えて欲しい、というお気持ちが伝わってきました。これは、彼氏さんとちゃんとした関係でいたいからこそではないかな…そう思いましたが、りささんはどう思われますか？
dialogue.English: As I listen to you, Risa, I sense a strong feeling of wanting him to truly consider you. I wonder if this comes from a desire to have a genuine relationship with your boyfriend... That's the impression I got, but what are your thoughts?

dialogue.content: ちゃんと考えてると思っているんですよね。彼は
dialogue.English: He thinks he is considering me properly.

dialogue.content: うん、なるほど。。
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, I see.

dialogue.content: だから…話を聴いてほしいって
dialogue.English: That's why... I just want him to listen to what I have to say.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。勘違いしてない？って気づいて欲しいし、話を聞いて欲しいですよね。
dialogue.English: Right. You want him to realize he might be misunderstanding, and you want him to listen.

dialogue.content: はい。あまり言葉にするのが私得意ではなくて
dialogue.English: Yes. I'm not very good at putting my feelings into words.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね
dialogue.English: I see, so that's the case.

dialogue.content: 自分でも、何が、引っかかっているのかわからなくて
dialogue.English: I'm not even sure myself what it is that's holding me back.

dialogue.content: はい…。そう思われているのですね。
dialogue.English: Yes... so that's how you're feeling.

dialogue.content: 思いが、言語化できたら、そのまま行ってみようと思って相談に来ました
dialogue.English: I came to this consultation hoping that if I could put my feelings into words, I could then go and express them.

dialogue.content: 言ってです。
dialogue.English: Express them, I mean.

dialogue.content: なるほど、そうだったのですね。そうしたら、改めて言葉にしてみませんか？
dialogue.English: I see, so that was your goal. In that case, shall we try to put them into words together?

dialogue.content: はいお願いします。
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: 思いだけを伝えようとすると、どうしても気持ちが溢れてしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: When you try to convey just the emotions, they can easily become overwhelming, can't they?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: だから、結論を伝えて、その理由や例えばどんな時のことか…順番にお伝えすると話しやすいかもしれません。
dialogue.English: So, it might be easier to communicate if you state your main point first, then the reason for it, and then a specific example... presenting it in that order.

dialogue.content: そこで、
dialogue.English: With that in mind,

dialogue.content: りささん、彼氏さんに一番伝えたい思いはなんでしょうか？改めて伺いたく思います。
dialogue.English: Risa, what is the most important thing you want to convey to your boyfriend? I'd like to ask you that again.

dialogue.content: ねえ、はなしきいてる?かな
dialogue.English: I suppose it's, 'Hey, are you listening to me?'

dialogue.content: そうですよね。それが一番伝えたいもの…それが結論ですよね。
dialogue.English: Right. That's what you most want to convey... that's your main point.

dialogue.content: でも、聞いてるよって言われる
dialogue.English: But he'll just say, 'I am listening.'

dialogue.content: ですよね。だからこそ、なぜその結論を伝えたいのか、「理由」を伝えましょう。
dialogue.English: Exactly. And that's precisely why it's important to also share the 'reason' you want to say that.

dialogue.content: 話を聞いて欲しいと感じるのは、どんな理由がありますか？
dialogue.English: What is your reason for feeling like you want him to listen?

dialogue.content: 不安になる、いつも一人で解決されて寂しくなる…とか。
dialogue.English: For example, does it make you feel anxious, or lonely because he always seems to resolve things on his own?

dialogue.content: 聞いてもらってるって感じられない。　不安だとか寂しいではないかな。
dialogue.English: I just don't feel like I'm being heard. I don't think it's about anxiety or loneliness.

dialogue.content: なるほど、そうですよね。大事な思いだと思います。
dialogue.English: I see, that makes sense. I think that's a very important feeling.

dialogue.content: そのあとは、「具体的にこういう時の話だよ」という例を上げてみましょう。具体的に、話を聞いてもらえなかった時のこと、思い浮かぶことはありますか？
dialogue.English: After that, let's try to provide a specific example, like, 'I'm talking about this specific situation.' Can you think of a specific instance when you felt you weren't being heard?

dialogue.content: ケーキ教室行きたい　って言ったら、言ってもいいよって言われる。いわれなくても行こうって思う
dialogue.English: When I said, 'I want to go to a baking class,' he said, 'You can go if you want.' I was planning to go whether he gave me permission or not.

dialogue.content: なんでいきたいのか　という気持ちみたいなの聞かない
dialogue.English: He doesn't ask about my feelings, like why I want to go.

dialogue.content: なるほど…。。バッチリです。
dialogue.English: I see... That's a perfect example.

dialogue.content: なんでいきたいのか…気持ちを聞いてくれない。
dialogue.English: He doesn't ask why you want to go... he doesn't ask about your feelings.

dialogue.content: でも、行きたいのなら言っていいよって言われる。話終了になる。
dialogue.English: But he just says, 'You can go if you want,' and the conversation ends there.

dialogue.content: なるほど…それは寂しいですよね。
dialogue.English: I see... That must feel lonely.

dialogue.content: 彼氏さんに「なんでいきたいのか」を聞いてもらえたら、どんな気持ちになれそうですか？
dialogue.English: If your boyfriend were to ask you, 'Why do you want to go?' how do you think you would feel?

dialogue.content: 私、思いを言葉にするのが得意ではないので、一緒に気持ちを探すというか、言語化したい
dialogue.English: Since I'm not good at putting my feelings into words, I want us to explore my feelings together, to help me verbalize them.

dialogue.content: 結婚したらどうしたい？とか。アパートに住むとかではなくて！
dialogue.English: Like asking, 'What do you want our married life to be like?' It's not just about things like living in an apartment!

dialogue.content: なるほど…大事な思いですよね！
dialogue.English: I see... That's a very important desire!

dialogue.content: 話を聞いて欲しい理由は、「一緒に気持ちを探して欲しいという思い」が強いのかもしれません。
dialogue.English: The reason you want him to listen might be strongly tied to your desire for him to help you explore your feelings together.

dialogue.content: アパート住んで、車大きくしてとかではなくて・・・結婚手何なのか探してみたい
dialogue.English: It's not about living in an apartment or getting a bigger car... I want to explore what marriage really is.

dialogue.content: うん、うん、そうですよね。
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: そうしたら、一旦話を整理しても良いですか？
dialogue.English: In that case, would it be alright if I organized our thoughts for a moment?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お話は「結論→理由→具体例→さいごにもう一度結論」で伝えると話やすく、伝わりやすいと思います。
dialogue.English: I believe it's easier to speak and be understood if you convey your message in the order of: 'Main Point -> Reason -> Specific Example -> and finally, your Main Point again'.

dialogue.content: その観点で一度整理してみます。間違っていたら言ってください
dialogue.English: I'll try to organize it from that perspective. Please let me know if anything is incorrect.

dialogue.content: ＊りささんの一番伝えたい「結論」結婚ってどういうものなのか、一緒に考えたい。＊それを伝えたい「理由」私は思いを言葉にするのが得意じゃないから、一緒に言葉にして欲しい＊具体例例えば、アパートに住んで、車を大きくして、とかそういう話ではなくて、もっと大事な何かがある。けれど、それを私は言葉にできない。＊もう一度「結論」を伝えるだから、結婚ってどういうものなのか、一緒に考えたい。
dialogue.English: *Risa's 'Main Point' you most want to convey: I want us to think together about what marriage really is. *The 'Reason' you want to convey this: Because I'm not good at putting my feelings into words, I want you to help me verbalize them. *Specific Example: For instance, it's not about things like living in an apartment or getting a bigger car; there's something more important. But I can't put that into words. *State the 'Main Point' again: That's why I want us to think together about what marriage really is.

dialogue.content: どう思われますか…？
dialogue.English: What do you think of that...?

dialogue.content: そうですね。一緒に考えたかったのですね。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: That's it. I just wanted to think about it together. Thank you so much.

dialogue.content: はい…きっとそれがりささんにとって大切なことだったのだと思います。
dialogue.English: Yes... I believe that was what was truly important to you.

dialogue.content: これをそのまま伝えてもしも受け入れてもらえたら…彼氏さんにとって結婚とは？また、りささんにとって結婚とは？それぞれの思いを共有してみてはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: If you convey this just as it is, and if he is receptive... perhaps you could both share what marriage means to him, and what marriage means to you. How would that be?

dialogue.content: 結婚て生活だよって言われたら、また相談に来ます。
dialogue.English: If he just says, 'Marriage is about day-to-day living,' I'll come back to talk again.

dialogue.content: もちろんです。私はいつでもお待ちしています。ずっと応援しています。
dialogue.English: Of course. I'll always be here for you. I'm always rooting for you.

dialogue.content: とにかくチャレンジしてみます。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: I'm going to give it a try. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: はい！りささんは、とても深く物事を考えられるし、浅い気持ちではいけないと考えられる、とても責任感が強い方ではないかと、私は思います
dialogue.English: Yes! Risa, I see you as someone who thinks about things very deeply and believes one shouldn't approach things superficially. I think you are a very responsible person.

dialogue.content: あなたならきっと大丈夫です。
dialogue.English: I'm sure you will be fine.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お時間がちょうど良いかとおもわれますが…今日は何か、お役に立てましたか？
dialogue.English: It looks like our time is about up... Was I able to be of any help to you today?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: よかったです。応援しています！また何かあったら、いつでもいらしてくださいね。
dialogue.English: I'm glad to hear that. I'm rooting for you! Please feel free to come back anytime if anything else comes up.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、ありがとうございます。そうしたら、今回はここで一旦終わりとさせていただきますね。
dialogue.English: Thank you as well. In that case, we will conclude our session here for today.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: はい。どうぞお体ご自愛ください。それでは、失礼いたします。
dialogue.English: Okay. Please take good care of yourself. Goodbye for now.

dialogue.content: ロールプレイありがとうございました。遅くなり失礼しました。勉強になりました、
dialogue.English: Thank you for the role-play. I apologize for running late. This was a great learning experience.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ時間が過ぎてしまい失礼いたしました。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Likewise, I apologize for going over our time. Thank you very much.
